description: data.london.gov.uk: district heating datasets is a collection of datasets listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.london.gov.uk. Coverage: the area served by data.london.gov.uk. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about district heating; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: London Heat Map - Reports and Data; Heat Networks Polling - January 2026; Borough Heat Mapping reports (2010-2012). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
